purpose: A response lists an http:// origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so any page on that cleartext origin can read the response.

groundTruth.rationale: The header names an origin whose scheme is http, and CORS compares origins literally: the browser will accept reads from that cleartext origin even though the API itself is served over HTTPS.
